liturgicalName: Easter Sunday: The Resurrection of the Lord

level1.title: Jesus Is Alive!
level1.story: Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early. The stone was rolled away! Peter and John ran to see. The tomb was empty: Jesus is risen!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Risen Jesus, I am so happy! Alleluia! Amen.

activity.title: An Easter gift
activity.intro: Draw a gift for the risen Jesus: a prayer, a song, or a good deed.
activity.prompt: An Easter gift box for Jesus with lilies and the empty tomb behind it

level2.title: The Empty Tomb
level2.story: On the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene came early to the tomb, while it was still dark. She saw the stone taken away and ran to tell Simon Peter and the other disciple. They ran together, and the other disciple got there first, but waited. Peter went in and saw the linen cloths and the napkin folded by itself. Then the other disciple went in, and he saw, and believed, for Jesus had risen from the dead.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why is the Resurrection the most important day?
What did John see that made him believe?
level2.prayer: Risen Lord, fill me with Easter faith. Alleluia! Amen.

activity.title: Easter hymn
activity.intro: Find the words from the hymn "Jesus Christ Is Risen Today".
